## 🌸 **About Radha Music Bot**

> **Radha Music Bot** is a powerful, feature-rich Telegram music bot designed to enhance your group voice chat experience. With its beautiful interface and extensive command set, Radha brings the joy of music to your Telegram groups. 

### 💫 **Powered by Madara**
> This bot is developed and maintained by **Madara**, ensuring top-quality code, regular updates, and premium performance.

### 🎵 **Music & Voice Chat**
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/start` | 🤖 Start the bot |
| `/help` | 📚 Get help menu with all commands |
| `/play` | ▶️ Play a song in voice chat |

| `/pause` | ⏸️ Pause the current stream |
| `/resume` | ▶️ Resume the paused stream |
| `/skip` | ⏭️ Skip to the next track in queue |
| `/end` | ⏹️ Clear queue and end the stream |
| `/queue` | 📋 Show the current queue |
| `/loop` | 🔁 Enable or disable loop mode |
| `/autoplay` | 🎯 Enable or disable autoplay |
| `/shuffle` | 🔀 Shuffle the current queue |
| `/seek` | ⏩ Seek to a specific time in track |
| `/speed` | 🚀 Change playback speed |
| `/playmode` | ⚙️ Change the play mode setting |

## 📦 **Installation**

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.9 or higher
- Telegram Bot Token from [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather)
- FFmpeg installed on your system

### Step-by-Step Guide

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/madara/radha-music-bot.git
cd radha-music-bot

# Install required packages
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Configure environment variables
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env file with your credentials

# Run the bot
python bot.py
```

### Docker Installation

```bash
# Build the Docker image
docker build -t radha-music-bot .

# Run the container
docker run -d --name radha-music-bot --env-file .env radha-music-bot
```

---

## 🔧 **Configuration**

Create a `.env` file with the following variables:

```env
BOT_TOKEN=your_bot_token_here
API_ID=your_api_id
API_HASH=your_api_hash
MONGO_URI=your_mongodb_uri
LOG_GROUP_ID=-1001234567890
OWNER_ID=your_telegram_id
BOT_NAME=Radha Music Bot
```
